checks.title: Functional correctness
checks.requirement: Valid supported inputs encrypt and decrypt correctly.

checks.title: Tampering rejection
checks.requirement: Modified ciphertext, nonce, authentication tag and associated data are rejected.

checks.title: Authentication before output
checks.requirement: Failed authenticated decryption exposes no plaintext and reports failure.

checks.title: Key and nonce handling
checks.requirement: Use a 16-byte key, 12-byte nonce and 16-byte tag for this profile; never reuse a nonce for encryption under the same key.

checks.title: Input boundaries
checks.requirement: Reject malformed lengths and handle output-buffer capacities safely.

assumptions: Trusted Windows CNG and operating system
Attacker cannot read the secret key
Attacker may modify encrypted inputs and observe public status/output

learning.policy: Changes require a completed testing phase, reviewed evidence, regression evaluation and explicit activation. Never train on raw model claims.
